content.text:
I fixed the orders table in `site/orders.html`. The header row had no "Total" column, although every row has a total cell. The headers sat one column out of line with the data, and the action column's header sat over the totals. I added `<th class="num">Total</th>` before the Actions header.

The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't look at the page in a browser, so I haven't seen the result.

STATUS: DONE
